_source: SIA 261:2020, chapter 5 «Schnee» -- clauses 5.1.4, 5.2.2 to 5.2.6 and 5.3.1 to 5.3.7, Figuren 2, 3 and 4 (and Figur 5 named, not transcribed), and Anhang D -- transcribed by hand from the French edition, Normen-Florian/SIA261-2020-FR.pdf pp. 26-29 and 115, the figures read off a render of the pages (11.10.2026, issue #36). The text of the clauses extracts as text; the curves of Figur 2 and 4 are straight segments between the grid values written here, read off the render and checked against the clauses that state them (5.3.4: mu_1 = 0.8; 5.3.5: Figur 4 for flat roofs over 20 m).
_note: Equation (9): q_k = mu · C_e · C_T · s_k. Equation (10): s_k = (1 + (h_0 / s_k_divisor)^2) · s_k_factor kN/m², at least s_k_min -- h_0 being the reference altitude of Anhang D, the altitude above sea level plus the correction of the map. Figur 2: each coefficient is a polyline of [alpha in degrees, mu] points, constant beyond its last point. Figur 3: the load models of the three roof forms, the curved roof's third column reading mu_3(alpha) with alpha_0 = 60°, the slope beyond which the roof carries no snow. Figur 4: mu_1 of a flat roof, by the larger of its two plan dimensions, for a roof whose length and width both exceed min_side (5.3.5) and whose slope is under max_slope.

max_altitude.note: 5.1.4: the provisions of chapter 5 do not apply to works above this altitude, the site's h_0. Woodcore computes a site above it all the same and warns in the tab only, the report saying nothing (spec 2026-10-14-neige-vent-affichage-altitude): a limit to warn of, not a refusal.

mono.note: Un toit incliné sur un seul pan doit être traité comme la moitié d'une toiture symétrique.

height_step.note: Bei Gebäuden mit abgestuften Dächern oder deren Dach an Bauwerke grösserer Höhe angrenzt: dreieckförmige Zusatzlast auf der unteren Dachfläche nach Figur 5 (Verdoppelung von mu_1 auf der Seite des Höhensprungs), Einflusslänge l_s = 2·h (p. 27). Not computed: a source says only that its roof has such a step (spec 2026-10-12-audit-issues-47-48-49, D-04).

cornice.note: Für Bauwerke über 800 m Meereshöhe ist bei auskragenden Dachteilen ein Schneeüberhang zu berücksichtigen: Höhe und Breite gleich der halben Schneehöhe auf dem Dach (aus der Schneelast nach 5.2.2 mit 3 kN/m³), Linienlast am Dachrand (p. 27). «Meereshöhe» is the site's altitude h_0, as for 5.1.4. Not computed: the report says it applies (D-04).
